name: Plannotator
description: Installs the Plannotator binary at build time and configures its runtime environment.

version.description: Plannotator release tag, such as v0.17.2, or latest.

remote.description: Default for PLANNOTATOR_REMOTE. Empty leaves it unset.

agentTerminalRemote.description: Default for PLANNOTATOR_AGENT_TERMINAL_REMOTE. Empty leaves it unset.

port.description: Default for PLANNOTATOR_PORT. Empty leaves it unset.

urlHost.description: Default for PLANNOTATOR_URL_HOST. Empty leaves it unset.
